Feature.Description: Allows a SiLA Client to control the simulation mode of a SiLA Server. In simulation mode, the server simulates device behavior without requiring actual hardware. This is useful for testing, development, and learning.

Command.Description: Switches the SiLA Server to simulation mode. All subsequent commands will be simulated rather than executed on real hardware.
Switches the SiLA Server out of simulation mode back to real mode. All subsequent commands will be executed on real hardware.

Property.Description: Indicates whether the SiLA Server is currently in simulation mode. True means the server is simulating, false means real hardware mode.
